HIGHLIGHTS.FILESYSTEM_DESC: Collections are plain files on your disk. No cloud sync, no proprietary lock-in.
HIGHLIGHTS.GIT_DESC: Every request is a readable file. Commit, branch, review, and collaborate using the tools you already know.
HIGHLIGHTS.PRIVACY_DESC: No account, no login. Pulse works entirely offline, your API keys never leave your machine.
HIGHLIGHTS.FAST_DESC: Built to be snappy. No bloated runtimes, just a fast, focused tool for exploring and testing APIs.
